lines.speaker: laras
lines.text: Today we've got data from the charity run form. That form was... well, filled in by people in a hurry.

lines.speaker: laras
lines.text: Hunt for the three main enemies: duplicates, empty values and impossible values.

lines.speaker: laras
lines.text: But if the data is already clean, don't hold it back. Careful doesn't mean suspicious of everything.

lines.speaker: laras
lines.text: Great! A report from dirty data is like cooking with spoiled ingredients. You washed them first.

lines.speaker: laras
lines.text: Tomorrow we start our first AI project. AI is only as good as its training data.
